labs.labName: Hans Stoll Financial Markets Research Center (FMRC), Owen Graduate School of Management
labs.professor: Robert E. Whaley (Valere Blair Potter Professor of Management and longtime FMRC Director; granted emeritus status in 2025 — confirm current director)
labs.department: Finance, Owen Graduate School of Management
labs.area: Financial markets research center (est. 1987): derivatives, volatility (Whaley created the VIX), market microstructure, and exchange-traded products. Runs focused research conferences (past speakers include Fed chairs and Nobel laureates), maintains financial databases, and hosts regular research seminars.
labs.skillsRelevant: Finance and econometrics; the center maintains financial databases, so data engineering, Python/R, and quantitative-finance skills are the clearly applicable toolkit for anyone assisting with its research.
labs.notes: Included as the flagship finance-research center per the fintech/Owen brief, but no source states undergrad involvement, and Owen is a graduate school — realistic access likely means cold-emailing Owen finance faculty (several study fintech/digital assets) rather than a posted program. Whaley received emeritus status at 2025 commencement, so center leadership may be in transition.
